column1: # Which tests a changed path needs. Read by scripts/regress-changed.py.
# Every row whose glob matches a changed path contributes its actions (a union,
# not first-match). Globs are fnmatch patterns on repo-relative paths, so `*`
#   case:S[,S]   rb-regress run cases whose ID contains S (see cases/**.toml ids)
#   emu:S        regress-emulators.sh scenarios whose ID contains S (emulator/cases.txt)
#   lib:F        cargo test --lib, filtered to test paths containing F
#   test:T       integration tests: `cargo test --test integration -- T::` for a module of
#                tests/integration/, or `--test T` for doc_parity / ui_scenarios
#   front:N      the front-end's own tests (gtk4, appkit, win32), where this host can build it
#   wide         too central to select from: run the batch level instead
#   skip         needs no tests (stops the "unmapped path" fallback)
# Some actions need no row: a crate under crates/ always gets `cargo test -p` and
# its 1.73 run, a file under src/ always gets `lib:` for its module path, a
# tests/ target gets `test:`, a case manifest gets `case:` for its own IDs, and an
# emulator script gets `emu:` for the scenarios that run it (all, for a shared one).
# A path matching no row and no automatic rule escalates to the batch level.
# ---- build and workspace: everything depends on these ------------------------
# ---- controllers and view-models: every shell drives these --------------------
# ---- crates: which cases and emulator scenarios exercise each ----------------
